title: FMCSA carrier lookup
description: Look up carriers through the official FMCSA QCMobile API. Provide your own free WebKey and at least one of USDOT number, MC/docket number, or carrier name.

webKey.title: FMCSA WebKey
webKey.description: Your free FMCSA QCMobile WebKey. Create one with Login.gov at https://mobile.fmcsa.dot.gov/QCDevsite/docs/getStarted. Apify stores this value encrypted. It is sent only to the official FMCSA API.

dotNumber.title: USDOT number
dotNumber.description: U.S. DOT number. Digits only; a leading USDOT label is ignored. Example from the FMCSA docs: 44110.
dotNumber.sectionDescription: Provide a USDOT number, an MC/docket number, a legal or DBA name, or any combination. Each match is saved as one dataset item.

docketNumber.title: MC / docket number
docketNumber.description: Motor carrier docket number. MC, FF, and MX prefixes are optional (MC-1515 and 1515 are the same lookup).

carrierName.title: Carrier name
carrierName.description: Legal name or DBA name. The official API returns at most 50 matches per request. Use maximum name results to keep fewer of them.

maxResults.title: Maximum name results
maxResults.description: How many name-search matches to save. Ignored for USDOT and docket lookups. The official API page size is 50.
